Name: Omri, Father of Ammihud
Summary: Father of Ammihud in the Jerusalem list, son of Imri son of Bani.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 9:4: Father of Ammihud in the Jerusalem list, son of Imri son of Bani.
LifeLesson: The mention of Omri in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.
